description: SiT2001B is a single-chip MEMS oscillator in a SOT23-5 package. It outputs LVCMOS/HCMOS at any frequency from 1 to 110 MHz, with frequency stability of ±20, ±25 or ±50 ppm. It runs from 1.62 V to 3.63 V depending on the voltage code, and draws 3.5 mA typical. The function of pin 3 is set by the ordering code: Output Enable, Standby or No Connect.

groups.description: VDD supply pin, 1.62–3.63 V depending on the voltage code. Current is 3.5–3.8 mA typical with no load at 20 MHz. Needs a 0.1 µF or larger decoupling capacitor to GND.
groups.name: POWER

groups.description: Pin 3 is a feature pin. The part-number option fixes it as Output Enable (output tri-states when low), Standby (device sleeps when low) or No Connect.
groups.name: CONTROL

groups.description: Single-ended LVCMOS clock output on pin 5, programmed at the factory to a frequency between 1 and 110 MHz.
groups.name: TIMING

pins.description: Feature pin; the ordering code fixes its function. In OE mode, H or open gives the specified frequency output and L puts the output in high impedance (only the output driver is disabled). In ST-bar mode, H or open gives the specified output and L puts the device to sleep, with the output weakly pulled low and supply current at I_std (0.6–2.6 µA typical). In NC mode the pin has no function. Logic thresholds are VIH ≥ 70% Vdd and VIL ≤ 30% Vdd. Internal pull-up is 87 kΩ typical (2 MΩ minimum when ST-bar is low).
pins.name: OE/~{ST}/NC

pins.description: Power supply voltage. Nominal options are 1.8, 2.5, 2.8, 3.0 and 3.3 V (±10%), plus 2.25–3.63 V. Absolute maximum is 4 V. Place a 0.1 µF or larger capacitor between VDD and GND.
pins.name: VDD

pins.description: Oscillator output, LVCMOS/HCMOS, 1–110 MHz. VOH ≥ 90% Vdd and VOL ≤ 10% Vdd at ±4 mA (3.0/3.3 V). Duty cycle is 45–55%. Rated with a 15 pF load.
pins.name: OUT

variants.notes: This is the only package. The Package Size character 'S' (e.g. SiT2001BI-S2-18E-25.000025D) means SOT23-5, 2.9 x 2.8 mm. The datasheet gives no body height, so only two dimensions are listed. The Feature Pin code (E/S/N) changes only the function of pin 3.
